question: How is the God of gods, Bhairava, characterized in this state?
premises: The God of gods is Bhairava, possessed of full power.
Bhairava is of the nature of reflective awareness.
Bhairava is connected with the union of emission and projection.
inference: Bhairava is the fully empowered supreme reality whose reflective awareness expresses itself through emission and projection.
uncertainties: The exact technical nuance of visarga and ākṣepa in this context may vary by commentary.
plain_english: To this extent, the God of gods, Bhairava, possessed of full power, is of the nature of reflective awareness and is united with emission and projection.
